# ComputeBestSpecs (CBS)

> Deterministic Computer Hardware Compatibility, Workload Concurrency, and Recommendation Engine.

ComputeBestSpecs calculates whether a computer can run real-world multi-app software stacks without performance bottlenecks or memory exhaustion. It uses verified vendor requirements, benchmark datasets (Blender Open Data, Phoronix, Llama.cpp decode tokens/sec), and mathematical concurrency models.

## Core Capabilities & Endpoints

- [Check My Computer](https://computebestspecs.vercel.app/check): Evaluate custom CPU, GPU, RAM, VRAM, and storage against multi-app workflows. Includes in-browser screenshot OCR and plain text spec import.
- [Find a Computer (Recommend)](https://computebestspecs.vercel.app/recommend): Find balanced hardware specifications for specific workflows (Software Development, 3D Rendering, Video Production, Local AI) across budget tiers.
- [Local AI & LLM Sizing](https://computebestspecs.vercel.app/ai): Sizing transformer models (7B to 70B+), KV cache memory scaling, quantization loss (FP16 to Q2), and tokens/second estimation.
- [Side-by-Side Comparison Matrix](https://computebestspecs.vercel.app/compare): Compare up to 3 computer profiles under identical workloads, highlighting bottlenecks and meaningful differences.
- [Software & Requirements Catalog](https://computebestspecs.vercel.app/software): Explore verified hardware requirements and workload intensity profiles for professional software.

## Key APIs

- `POST /api/compatibility/evaluate`: Deterministic evaluation of a hardware profile against an array of workloads.
- `GET /api/health`: Health status and engine version telemetry.

## System Invariants & Guarantees

1. **Deterministic Authority**: Compatibility scores and bottlenecks are computed by reproducible mathematical formulas, never hallucinated by generative models.
2. **Zero Server Image Uploads**: Screenshot OCR is processed 100% locally in client-side Web Workers.
3. **Structured Provenance**: All hardware requirements are linked to official vendor source documentation with verification timestamps.
